# Sharp Sighted

Sharp Sighted is a multi-genre photography practice based in North Texas, founded July 2022 by Dean Draper. Serves the 121 corridor and broader DFW: Allen, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Lewisville, The Colony, Coppell, Roanoke, Denton, Grapevine, Southlake, Colleyville, Westlake.

Disabled-owned. Neurodiversity and diversity friendly.

## Structure

Sharp Sighted operates as a single brand (legal entity: Sharp Sighted Studio) with four web properties:

- sharpsightedstudio.com — the umbrella hub (this site). Routes visitors to the right specialist branch.
- sharpsighted.photos — Portraits, headshots, lifestyle, personal branding. Primary pillar: Seen.
- sharpsighted.media — Real estate media. Primary pillar: Sharp.
- sharpsighted.studio — Community, education, the 10% Rule. Primary pillar: Human.

## Tagline

Stay Sharp. Stay Seen. Stay Human.

## Three Pillars

Sharp — Tuned. Fit. Your best self. Presenting at your highest level — your body, your image, your space, your craft.

Seen — Authentic visibility. Standing in your truth. Being truly seen, and cutting through the noise of saturated markets.

Human — Community. Warmth. The 10%. Collaboration, genuine connection, and the standing commitment to give 10% of time, resources, or effort to causes that matter.

## What Sharp Sighted is not

A family photographer. A maternity or newborn photographer. A wedding photographer. A bargain shooter.
